entities.summary: The Nádasdy Mansion is a Neo-Gothic style manor house designed by István Linzbauer and Alajos Hauszmann situated on 24 hectares in Nádasdladány, Hungary. It dates from 1873 to 1876, and belonged to the Nádasdy family. It was used for the exterior of the vampires' mansion in the Underworld film series and Chateau de Roussillon in Now You See Me: Now You Don't.
